response.original_title: [FAQs-Dispute-Process] Princess Cruise Dispute Service Number for Booking and Refund Issues
response.overview: Princess Cruises does not have a dedicated "dispute service" phone number 1-866-259-1002. Instead, customer complaints, billing issues, and post-cruise concerns are handled through their main customer service 1-866-259-1002 and customer relations departments.Phone Numbers for Complaints & Customer Support United States Customer Service / General Support: Call 1-866-259-1002 (1-800-PRINCESS) for general pre-cruise support, billing questions, or immediate assistance. Alternative US Complaints / Customer Relations Line: Call 1-866-259-1002 (Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM EST) for post-cruise complaints and customer relations issues.Email & Escalation Contacts Customer Relations Email: Send post-cruise feedback or formal complaints to customerrelations@princesscruises.com. Online Support: Use the official Princess Cruises Contact Form 1-866-259-1002 or live chat via their website or mobile app.
